name: Banh it la gai
summary: A cone of ramie leaf and fresh sticky-rice flour, with a mung-bean and dried-coconut filling. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định addresses it to Quy Nhon. Tháp Bánh Ít is a Cham tower, not this cake.
origin: Quy Nhon, on the provincial portal. The verse on Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định sends the cake to Binh Dinh.
texture: The portal says the skin is glossy black, wrapped in young banana leaf, and chewy and smooth without sticking to the teeth.
taste: It names a little bitterness from the leaf, sweetness from the sugar, the scent of sticky rice, fat from the coconut, the mung bean, and ginger.
howToEat: Eat the cone as it is wrapped. The portal does not name a dip.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The address field is Quy Nhon. A shop street was not printed.
seoTitle: Banh it la gai — Quy Nhon ramie cake
seoDescription: Bánh ít lá gai is a black ramie-leaf cone with mung bean and coconut. The provincial portal addresses it to Quy Nhon. A price is Check on arrival.
